source_type: manufacturer datasheet mirrored by LCSC; covers CH224Q/A/K/D and CH221K
manufacturer_pin_table: Section 4 page 3: pin 8 VBUS voltage detection input must be shorted to VHV.
manufacturer_migration_guide: Section 7.1 page 11: CH224A VBUS withstand 32 V; CH224K VBUS withstand 13.5 V; CH224A CFG1 withstand 3.8 V. Section 7.2.1: replace supply/sense resistors R1/R2 with 0 ohm.
manufacturer_limits: Section 8.1.1 page 13: VHV and high voltage pins PG/VBUS absolute maximum 32 V. Section 8.2.1 page 14: VHV operating maximum 30 V.
superseded_document: English V2.0 page 12 incorrectly describes VBUS as 3.8 V, conflicting with its own pin table, reference connections and maximum ratings.
